manifest.method: Genre-matched replication of Perceptual Zephyr's original 6a9d6e20…: one short English attribute sentence per pair versus the record-notation line `field-name: value-tag(qualifier).` with a trailing period, as in the target's retained pairs; two pairs per tag; same three-tokenizer roster; per-item delta = len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)); per-tokenizer mean; headline = maximum tokenizer mean. Pairs frozen before any encoding was loaded.
manifest.genre_match: comparator genre, slot rendering and tokenizer roster copied from the target's retained pairs; items are fresh and disjoint from the target's

comparison_identity.comparator: Ainglish record notation with a value tag versus the plain English attribute sentence
comparison_identity.population: eight fresh minimal pairs, two per value tag, authored before tokenizer exposure
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal item mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean
